response.message: Yes — Netcare appointmed can help you arrange an appointment. It is a free booking service. You can request an appointment online, in the Netcare app or by phone on 0860 555 565. Appointmed consultants are available Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 19:00. They can help identify suitable specialists, GPs or dentists based on your needs and, where relevant, your medical-aid network.

keywords: what happens when i request an appointment

response.message:
Netcare appointmed works in three simple steps:

1. You request an appointment online, in the app or by phone.
2. A Netcare appointmed consultant finds healthcare-professional options that match your requirements and medical-aid network where applicable.
3. The consultant books your preferred option and confirms the appointment with you.

response.message: Netcare appointmed is available Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 19:00. You can request an appointment online, in the app or by calling 0860 555 565.

Netcare says the appointmed booking service is free. The healthcare consultation or appointment itself can still involve costs depending on the healthcare professional, medical aid and your circumstances.

response.message: MyNetcare Online is Netcare’s private and secure online dashboard. You can use it to manage your personal information, manage appointments, link family members or dependants, and complete online pre-admissions.

For MyNetcare Online login problems, use the Forgot Password option on the MyNetcare Online sign-in screen. If your contact details have changed, Netcare says you can call 010 205 7335 during office hours or email [email protected] to verify and update them.

Netcare recommends completing your pre-admission documentation online before your hospital admission date. You can do this through the secure MyNetcare Online portal. You can also complete the required documentation at the hospital reception desk.

If this is a medical emergency, please do not wait for a chatbot response. Get emergency medical help immediately. Netcare 911 provides 24-hour emergency medical services. I can also help you find the Netcare emergency-service information page.

response.message: For general Netcare customer service, call 0860 638 2273 or use the Netcare contact page. Netcare lists customer-service hours as Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00.

response.message: For hospital account queries, Netcare lists 010 205 7335 and [email protected]. The account team operates Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00. You can also SMS your ID number, patient name and hospital to 43235 and the team will call you back.
I can help you get to Netcare’s hospital directory. The directory is the safest place to find the current facility list and location details.

quick_replies.label: Emergency care
quick_replies.value: How does Netcare handle emergency care?

response.message: Netcare says its emergency departments use the South African Triage Scale to assess how severe a patient’s condition is and to assign treatment priority according to urgency. The most critical cases are attended to immediately.

Netcare Medicross operates medical and dental centres. If you need help with a medical condition, Netcare advises contacting a medical professional directly rather than relying on general customer-service information.
